title: Covered Days of a Corrected TRICARE Select Inpatient Stay and the Inpatient Mental Health Authorization
content:
The covered days of a corrected **TRICARE Select** inpatient stay are read against the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization at the stay's facility, as recorded in Referrals and Authorizations.

**Rule.** Where an approved Inpatient Mental Health Authorization for the patient at the stay's facility starts on the admission date and authorizes fewer days than the stay billed, the covered days of a corrected stay are the days it authorizes; where the stay's service class is in the tier's list of service classes needing prior authorization and no such approved authorization is on file, a corrected stay has no covered day; otherwise every billed inpatient day of a corrected stay is covered.

On every TRICARE Select tier - the four TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B - the service class needing prior authorization is the inpatient mental health admission.

## Records read

- the reversed stay line: its service class, facility, admission date and billed inpatient days;
- Referrals and Authorizations: the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization - its status (approved), its servicing facility, the date it starts and the days it authorizes.

## Truth table

| Approved authorization at the facility starting on the admission date | Days it authorizes compared with days billed | Service class needs prior authorization | Covered days |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | fewer | any | the days it authorizes |
| yes | equal or more | any | every billed day |
| no | - | yes (inpatient mental health admission) | none |
| no | - | no (acute inpatient admission) | every billed day |

## Hypothetical stays

- Inpatient mental health stay billed for 9 days, approved authorization at the same facility from the admission date for 6 days: 6 covered days.
- The same stay with the approved authorization at a different facility, or starting on another day: no covered day.
- Acute inpatient admission billed for 5 days with no authorization: 5 covered days.
